findings.text: Auth-before-query: requireAuth (main.go:531) runs before r.URL.Query(); unauthenticated q (even 600 bytes) returns 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer, never 400/200. TestNotesSearchAuthRequired + live probe.
Owner-scope predicate order holds: ListNotes(session.UserID) (main.go:547) then q narrows only; foreign search returns []; foreign DELETE -> 404. TestNotesSearchIsolation/TestDeleteForeignNote.
q cap is 512 decoded bytes before trim/scan (main.go:541-545); 512 -> 200, 513 -> 400; multi-byte 512B accepted, 514B rejected. TestNotesSearchQueryTooLong.
Case-insensitive substring via strings.ToLower on both sides (main.go:546,551); stored text unchanged. Residual: no locale-aware Unicode folding (documented non-goal).
XSS closed: note text rendered only via textContent (app.js:421-422); zero innerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML/document.write/eval in web/*.js; SEARCH-E2E-15 asserts literal rendering.

Delete/IDOR/status: auth first (401), method (405 Allow: DELETE), id parse (400), owner-checked DeleteNote (404 foreign/missing). TestDeleteForeignNote/TestNotesMethodNotAllowed/TestNotesPrefixBoundary.
UI load/delete race guarded by loadGeneration (app.js:623,634,525-532); stale load cannot resurrect a deleted note; busy affordances released. CR-01 E2E regression passes.

Residual: handleUnauthorized (app.js:484-501) clears storage/query and locks UI but does not clear the in-memory notes array or rendered list before the 200ms redirect to /login. Not cross-user exploitable in practice (session expiry = same user; login is a full reload). Low, accepted for s23 triage.

Residual: logout is client-side only (app.js:789-794); no server token revocation, so a captured token remains valid up to sessionTTL=24h (main.go:31). invariants.json dont[0] keeps auth/session out of scope; accepted design boundary.
Auth bypass via path normalization refuted: Go 1.22+ ServeMux 301-collapses '//' and '..' before the handler; canonical target still enforces requireAuth; no open redirect or traversal surface.

Test/doc quality gaps: no Go test pins '+1'/'-1'/encoded-slash id forms or '//' 301 normalization; INV-UI-E2E-PREVIEW.test_ref points at scenario-evidence.json absent from the tree (invariant stays proposed); web_ui_test.go is a literal-string oracle. Safe but unregressed.
Info: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 210000 iterations with 16B salt/32B key and dummy-hash timing equalization; below OWASP 600k but acceptable for this app; auth is out of scope for the feature.

proofs: 13 adversarial httptest probes against a /tmp copy of main.go: unauth 600B q -> 401; 512B -> 200; 513B -> 400; multi-byte 512B/514B boundary; delete +1 owner 204 / foreign 404 / -1 404; // path 301 to canonical with auth still enforced; mixed-case search match
